lines.zh: 我每一步都让石地发响。
lines.en: Every step of mine makes the stone ground sound.

lines.zh: 我的长颈在洞顶下低着。
lines.en: I keep my long neck low under the cavern roof.
I walk on four legs across the lichen.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边摆动长尾。
lines.en: I swing my long tail as I go.
I shoulder stalagmites aside.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪动庞大的身体。
lines.en: I move my vast bulk slowly.
I walk down along the cavern wall.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住半面岩壁。
lines.en: My shadow covers half the rock wall.
I stretch my neck to test the way.
I make my rounds in the primordial cavern.
I stand and breathe slowly.
The cavern's glow falls on my back.
I lift my head and reach the roof.

lines.zh: 四百点血，脚一落就平一片。
lines.en: Four hundred points. One step flattens ground.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像山的一部分。
lines.en: I hold still, like part of the mountain.
The cavern hums for a long while.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，眼里没有怒意。
lines.en: I blink slowly; there is no anger in my eyes.

lines.zh: 洞穴里的水汽在我的皮上结。
lines.en: Damp gathers on my hide.
I listen to water dripping far off.

lines.zh: 我把头搁在一块岩台上。
lines.en: I rest my head on a rock ledge.

lines.zh: 我摆了一下尾巴，扫起尘。
lines.en: I flick my tail and raise dust.
My toes sink into the soft earth.
The ceiling is low; I keep my head down.
I taste the cavern's smell.

lines.zh: 我在这里比任何东西都老。
lines.en: I am older than anything here.

lines.zh: 我一脚踩碎了一块石壳。
lines.en: I crush a stone shell underfoot.
You are very small in this cavern.
I do not mean to harm you.

lines.zh: 暝煌龙走了之后，我才来。
lines.en: I came only after the other dragon left.

lines.zh: 我认得这里每一条裂缝。
lines.en: I know every crack here.

lines.zh: 你手里的叶子，也许我会吃。
lines.en: Those leaves in your hand — I might eat them.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，我一脚能盖住。
lines.en: One of my feet could cover where you stand.
My neck reaches the cavern roof.

lines.zh: 你想骑上来？得有东西换。
lines.en: You want to ride? That will cost something.

lines.zh: 我低头看，也要花点力气。
lines.en: Lowering my head to look costs me effort.

lines.zh: 这具身子不适合狭窄处。
lines.en: This body is not made for narrow places.
Step back; I am about to turn.
Chasing you is not something I do.
My hide twitches once.
That half step dents the floor.
That barely scratched me.

lines.zh: 我低吼，声音在洞里回荡。
lines.en: I growl, and it rolls around the cavern.
I shake the rubble off my back.

lines.zh: 我一脚踩碎了旁边的石头。
lines.en: I crush a stone beside me underfoot.
That pain did not even crack a scale.
You have displeased me.

lines.zh: 我身上有一道新的刮痕。
lines.en: There is a new scrape on my hide.
I am still standing. You should back away.
That dish of greens smells good.

lines.zh: 你举到我嘴边，我自己来。
lines.en: Hold it to my mouth; I will take it myself.
I stretch my neck to reach your palm.
That much grass will not fill a gap in my teeth.

lines.zh: 吃完，你可以上来一会儿。
lines.en: After this, you may climb up for a while.
Grass juice is smeared on my tongue.
Do not pull your hand back; it will fall.
This is curious to chew.
A little more and I will let you ride.

lines.zh: 我一抬脚就能压平地面。
lines.en: One step of mine flattens the ground.
What you struck was a leg.

lines.zh: 我站得像洞壁的一部分。
lines.en: I stand still as part of the cave wall.
You were the one knocked back.
I lift a foot to spare you.
We left prints in the ground.

lines.zh: 尾巴带起的风先撞到你。
lines.en: The wind of my tail hits you before the tail does.
I barely felt that.
You have backed against the rock wall.

lines.zh: 我挪开一条腿，让你过去。
lines.en: I shift one leg aside to let you pass.
Dust falls from the cavern roof.
I permit you to climb up for a while.
Hold my spine and do not let go.
I will trample this ground flat.
Sit firm; I am turning.
You are lighter than anything I have carried.
I take one step and you lurch three times.
When the time is up, you must come down.

lines.zh: 我们一起巡视这片洞穴。
lines.en: We patrol this cavern together.
Do not stand up on my back.
Do not hurry me; I am slow.
One curl of the tongue and it is in my mouth.
It is tiny in my mouth.
I taste it and spit it out.
My tongue cannot hold it.
I set it down on a rock ledge.
It fell between my teeth.

lines.zh: 我四点的攻击，全靠这身重量。
lines.en: My attack is all in this weight.
Too hard; it jars my teeth.
I push it toward you with my snout.
It is light as a feather in my mouth.
I turn to face you squarely.
The cave walls narrow the way out.

lines.zh: 暝煌龙的腿，抬起来像山。
lines.en: A rex's leg lifts like a hill.

lines.zh: 我站着，你就整个在影里。
lines.en: Standing here, I shadow all of you.
I would rather not tread on you.
You have retreated among the stalagmites.
I lower my neck slowly.
This ground will give way.
My tail blocks the way.
If you do not move, I will.

lines.zh: 你喘一口气，我前进一寸。
lines.en: Each breath you take, I close an inch.

lines.zh: 洞顶太低了，我只能这样。
lines.en: The roof is too low; this is all I can do.

lines.zh: 我四格的身子，一踏就平。
lines.en: Four blocks of me flattens the ground.
I press my long neck down in front of you.
My foot is raised over your head.
Every step you retreat, I follow.
My foot is raised above you.
The dust falls first.
The cavern wall closes off your retreat.
I am in no hurry; the cavern is only so large.
I lower myself a little more.
You are standing on loose earth.
My tail swings slowly around.
I can hear you breathing.
My lowered shadow swallows you.
The ground here is beginning to crack.
I stamp down on the count of three.
You are standing in what will become a crater.
Half a step more and the ground goes flat.
Now — hold on.
I bring one foot down hard.
The ground is stamped into a pit.
One stomp snaps every stalagmite.
A row of stalagmites goes down.
I lower my neck and push.

lines.zh: 地面的震动传到你脚上。
lines.en: The ground's shudder reaches your feet.
One stomp of mine flattens the terrain.
A shower of rubble falls from the roof.
You rolled into a crack in the rock.
I step back half a pace to give you room.
The ground is flat, as if scraped.
I have raised my foot again.
You are covered in dust.
The shape of this ground has changed.

lines.zh: 从原始洞穴深处传来一声低鸣。
lines.en: A low call comes from deep in the primordial cavern.

lines.zh: 我慢慢从石柱后面走出来。
lines.en: I walk slowly out from behind a stone pillar.

lines.zh: 我的脚一落地，灰尘就起来。
lines.en: Dust rises when my foot lands.

lines.zh: 暝煌龙倒下之后，这里空了。
lines.en: After the other dragon fell, this place was empty.

lines.zh: 石柱之间，我探出长脖子。
lines.en: Between the pillars, my long neck comes out.

lines.zh: 洞壁的回音绕了好几圈。
lines.en: The echo off the walls circles several times.

lines.zh: 我的脖子探出石柱之间。
lines.en: My neck comes out between the pillars.
This cavern is room enough for me to move.
Stone chips coat my hide.

lines.zh: 我低下头看这个新的东西。
lines.en: I lower my head to look at this new thing.

lines.zh: 我呼吸时，洞里的空气都动了。
lines.en: When I breathe, the air in the cavern moves.
I walk slowly into the open space.
I know these rock strata.
When I appear, the noise dies down.
Behind the pillars, my long neck shows first.
I gather my tail in.

lines.zh: 洞穴里没有别的这么大的东西。
lines.en: There is nothing else this large in the cavern.
I raise my head and strike the roof.
I settle and wait for you to move first.

lines.zh: 这片地够结实，能承住我。
lines.en: This ground is solid enough to bear me.

lines.zh: 火光照在我皮上，我不怕。
lines.en: Firelight on my hide does not frighten me.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，洞底震了一下。
lines.en: I fall from a height and the cavern floor shakes.

lines.zh: 这洞里的水居然没到我背上。
lines.en: The water here has risen to my back.
The blast throws rubble everywhere.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我的厚皮，只进了一点。
lines.en: Something pierced my thick hide — barely.

lines.zh: 咒力顺着我的长颈爬上来。
lines.en: The spell crawls up my long neck.

lines.zh: 这洞穴里能吃的东西太少。
lines.en: There is very little to eat in this cavern.
The thunder rolls in the cavern a long while.
The floor beneath me has vanished.
